recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, desaturated composition featuring a central black iron cage containing a solitary hooded figure and a simple bed, set within a vast, empty, dimly lit studio environment with a single overhead spotlight creating long radial shadows.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical bars of the cage echoing the verticality of the central figure
High contrast between the dark cage/subject and the pale, spotlighted floor
Symmetry of the cage placement against the vast negative space of the background
Radial shadows extending from the cage base toward the viewer
coreInvariants: Low-key lighting with a visible floor-level spotlight effect

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The cage is centered horizontally and vertically, occupying approximately 40% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark silhouette of the hooded figure inside the cage.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the central figure, moves outward to the cage structure, follows the radial shadows to the bottom edge, then rises to the typography at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive dark gray negative space at the top and sides creates a sense of crushing isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black for the subject and background shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool, desaturated light gray for the spotlighted floor.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the typographic elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Near-zero saturation; value is used exclusively to define form and depth through light falloff.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying weights or tracking.
graphicDevices: Thin vertical divider line between logo and text

candidateDirections.reason: Clean geometric structure and modern feel.
Open counters and similar geometric proportions.
Classic geometric sans with sharp points.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle shot of a black iron prison cage in the center of a vast, empty, dark gray studio. Inside the cage is a small bed and a man in a black hoodie standing still. A single spotlight from above hits the floor around the cage, creating long, soft radial shadows on the light gray floor. The top half of the image is empty dark space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a geometric sans-serif title in all-caps at the top center. Use wide letter spacing and a light weight. Include a thin vertical line as a separator if a logo mark is used to the left.

verificationChecks: Is the tracking on the text sufficiently wide?
Does the spotlight create a clear circular pool of light on the floor?

adjustableVariables: Height of the typography in the frame
Posture of the figure inside the cage
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: High-definition textures on the iron bars

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the shadows radiate correctly from the light source
Check that the text is legible against the dark background
Verify the desaturation is consistent across the entire image
Confirm the figure is silhouetted and not overly detailed
recipe.reuseFormula: Centralized industrial object + vast dark negative space + wide-tracked geometric sans-serif = Cinematic Isolation Aesthetic.
